en:
Ah, I don't have anything to say...
I just thought...we could hang out?

<CLT=cltMIND>I thought that training with me and
Kaito would bring us closer...

...What's with your reaction?
You're the one who invited me.

S-Sorry, I was just surprised.
I honestly thought you'd reject me.

...All this time, I assumed I was just going to
train with two idiots, you and Kaito...

And I thought it'd be faster to give in
to Kaito's demands...
<CLT=cltMIND>...Not sure how to feel about that.

Even after hearing that, do you still want
to hang out with me?
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Maki for a while?

Fine, I'll hang out with you. But I think you'll
end up wasting your time on me.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time with Maki,
talking about nothing...
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki and I grew a little closer today.
